lines.t: Verse 1
Here at Your feet, I come undone
Held by the kindness of the Holy One
You draw me close, You call me near
And everything else fades when You are here
Verse 2
You know my heart, You know my ways
Yet You have loved me through all my days
No fear remains, no shame survives
Only Your love that gives me life
Chorus
Your love is a fountain, let it flow through me
Let all that You are fill me completely
Let there be nothing between us now
No hidden walls, I lay them down
Your love is a fire, refining my heart
Let every flame tear the old apart
Purify all I’ve held inside
Till only Your life remains in mine
Verse 3
“Come and drink,” I hear You say
You are the truth, the life, the way
You are the vine, and I remain
In every breath, in every vein
Chorus
Your love is a fountain, let it flow through me
Let all that You are fill me completely
Let there be nothing between us now
No hidden walls, I lay them down
Your love is a fire, refining my heart
Let every flame tear the old apart
Purify all I’ve held inside
Till only Your life remains in mine
Bridge
As You are one with the Father above
Draw me into that same perfect love
Take every part that stands in the way
And shape my heart to fully stay
Bridge 2
YahuShua, You’re all I desire
Closer than breath, my constant fire
I give You all, no need to hide
Be my life, be lifted high
Final Chorus
Your love is a fountain, alive in me
Now I am Yours, and I am free
There is no distance, no divide
You are alive here inside
Your love is a fire, steady and bright
Leading my heart into Your light
All that I am, I give to You
Make me one, forever true
Outro
Draw me in…
Closer still…
One with You…
